name: Expedition X
description: Whether trekking through the remote jungles of Cambodia in search of a legendary ape-man or exploring the secrets of the world’s largest cave system right here in the United States, the Expedition X team is taking viewers to the stranger side of the unknown.

videos.title: Malpelo Monster Shark
videos.overview:
2025 Shark Week Special.

Hundreds of miles off the coast of Columbia, Phil and Heather join a scientific team trying to locate and tag El Monstruo, a huge shark seen in the waters off Malpelo Island, home to unique shark populations.

videos.title: Atomic Sharks
videos.overview: Phil and Heather investigate disturbing reports of aggressive mutant sharks in Micronesia's Marshall Islands. Joined by a team of scientists, they dive in dangerous waters to explore whether the region's terrifying atomic past is to blame.

videos.title: Mothman Phenomenon
videos.overview: Jessica Chobot and Phil Torres dive into the legend of Mothman by searching for clues in a long-sealed bunker and a top-secret Air Force base.

videos.title: Cambodia's Jungle Monster
videos.overview: The surge of human activity surrounding the discovery of an ancient city sends Phil Torres and Jessica Chobot deep in the Cambodian jungle to search for a monster that has been terrifying locals for centuries.

videos.title: Terror on Doll Island
videos.overview: Phil Torres and Jessica Chobot power through camera malfunctions and emotional breakdowns in order to find an explanation of what is happening on the Island of the Dolls -- a dangerous place that locals have long avoided.

videos.title: Mystery in Mammoth Cave
videos.overview: Phil Torres and Jessica Chobot investigate a strange phenomenon that's been haunting Mammoth Cave for generations.

videos.title: Mt Adams UFO Encounter
videos.overview: Phil Torres and Jessica Chobot follow headlines of hidden hangars and strange orbs of light into an active volcano in Washington.

videos.title: The Amazons Cursed Ruins
videos.overview: Adventurer Josh Gates, scientist Phil Torres and paranormal researcher Jessica Chobot investigate reports of supernatural encounters, mysterious creatures and extraterrestrial phenomena.

videos.title: Lake of the Dead
videos.overview: Phil and Jessica head to Lake Lanier, a manmade lake that covers over 20 cemeteries and the bodies still buried there; they investigate in and around the deadliest lake in America to uncover rumors of drownings and ghostly encounters.

videos.title: Curse of the Old West Outlaw
videos.overview: Josh Gates' team heads west to investigate America's most haunted town. Locals claim the spirit of a notorious bandit spooks the town because of a wrongful hanging. Phil and Jess' investigation leads them into a dangerous abandoned gold mine.

videos.title: Round-Up at Death Ranch
videos.overview: Bizarre cattle mutations in the Pacific Northwest lead Josh Gates to send his team to investigate. The baffling deaths make Jessica and Phil question if the cattle were victims of newly arrived apex predators or the target of something more sinister.

videos.title: Terror of the Bell Witch
videos.overview: Josh Gates dives into one of America's oldest witch stories. In the Tennessee backwoods, locals report being attacked in a vast cave system. Jess and Phil go underground and uncover frightening piles of bones as well as potential human remains.

videos.title: Ghosts in the Swamp
videos.overview: Terrifying apparitions in a Texas swamp lead Josh Gates to send his team to the notorious Big Thicket. The area is crawling with venomous snakes but what really frightens Phil and Jess are mysterious Ghost Lights that have haunted locals for generations.

videos.title: Devil in the Forest
videos.overview: Josh sends Jessica and Phil to hunt for the infamous Jersey Devil.

videos.title: America's Lake Monster
videos.overview: Phil and Jess investigate a 30-foot serpent in Lake Champlain.

videos.title: An American Werewolf
videos.overview: Josh joins Jess and Phil to track down a half-man, half-beast in Wisconsin.

videos.title: The Beast of Bray Road
videos.overview: Josh, Jessica and Phil close in on the Beast of Bray Road.

videos.title: UFO's over New Mexico
videos.overview: Responding to recent UFO sightings, Josh Gates sends his team to New Mexico for a new investigation into the infamous, unsolved Socorro Landing Incident; using never-before-used technology and with new witnesses, Jess and Phil look to solve Socorro.

videos.title: Ghosts in the Canal
videos.overview: Josh wants to investigate ghostly sightings and terrifying sounds coming from an abandoned canal along the Potomac. Jess and Phil dive into the murky depths and search secret tunnels that make this America's most haunted waters.

videos.title: Canyon of the Apes
videos.overview: Chasing Bigfoot's origin story, Phil and Jessica uncover a rash of recent sightings and bone-chilling new evidence in the Pacific Northwest. New leads about a frightening encounter send them into rocky, dangerous terrain along Mount St. Helens.

videos.title: Aliens of the Deep
videos.overview: Shocking, declassified video captured by the U.S. Navy triggers Jess and Phil's investigation into mysterious, supersonic craft flying above -- and racing below -- the waters off California's Catalina Island.

videos.title: Into the Alien Ocean
videos.overview: Jess and Phil's investigation into the phenomenon of unidentified submerged objects off the coast of Catalina Island intensifies after the discovery of an extraterrestrial underwater base between the island and the mainland.

videos.title: Terror in Appalachia
videos.overview: Hikers are going missing amid reports of grotesque, human-like creatures prowling Appalachia's Great Smoky Mountains. Phil and Jess venture into the unforgiving wilderness to investigate the truth behind terrifying sightings of feral people.

videos.title: The Van Meter Monster
videos.overview: Horrified locals in southern Iowa are reporting sightings of a giant winged creature -- the same mysterious beast that terrorized the town of Van Meter 100 years ago. Phil and Jess are on a mission to unearth clues to what's lurking in the shadows.

videos.title: Thailand's UFO Cult
videos.overview: Josh sends Phil and Jessica to Bangkok, Thailand, to search for the group behind terrifying warnings of global catastrophes and natural disasters.

videos.title: Graveyard of the Great Lakes
videos.overview: Lake Superior's treacherous waters have claimed thousands of lives. After witnesses report ghostly lights and sounds, Phil and Jess dive into an investigation to uncover the truth behind alleged paranormal activity on Michigan's Shipwreck Coast.

videos.title: Ghost Fort of the Civil War
videos.overview: Phil and Jess gain unprecedented access to investigate ghostly voices and apparitions in the massive Civil War stronghold, Ft. Morgan. The clock is ticking; Gulf Coast storms threaten to destroy the 200-year-old Fort and the mysteries inside.

videos.title: Civil War Ghosts in the Bay
videos.overview: Jess and Phil dive deeper into the tragic history of Fort Morgan; haunting bell sounds beyond the Fort’s walls trigger a dangerous search in the churning waters off Alabama’s coast; “Kindred Spirits’” Amy Bruni and Adam Berry join the investigation.

videos.title: Ring of Fire UFOs
videos.overview: Phil and Jess probe the science behind geology's strangest phenomena while investigating mysterious objects flying around Mexico's tallest active volcano.

videos.title: The Ozark Howler
videos.overview: Jess and Phil venture deep into the Ozarks to investigate a mysterious predatory beast. Eyewitnesses, surveillance footage and new recordings of bone-chilling howls lead the team to a shocking revelation about the legendary creature.

videos.title: Mexico's Haunted Cenotes
videos.overview: In the Yucatan, Phil and Jess investigate watery caverns believed to be portals to the Maya underworld. Some say angry spirits are to blame for strange lights and bizarre animal behavior, but the sacred cenotes hide secrets far darker than any legend.

videos.title: Avalanche Ghost Train
videos.overview: At the site of America's deadliest avalanche, witnesses report bizarre apparitions and sickly feelings of dread. Phil and Jess venture deep into Washington's Cascade Mountains to investigate a shocking cover-up and test a mind-bending scientific theory.

videos.title: Alaskan Lake Monster
videos.overview: Phil and Jess search whitewater rapids and a frigid Alaskan lake for a legendary beast that's now the target of serious scientific inquiry. Armed with new eyewitness accounts and advanced underwater robotics, the team takes a deep dive for answers.

videos.title: Monster of the Amazon
videos.overview: Deep in the Peruvian jungle, where deadly wildlife lurks at every turn, a supersized beast is terrifying locals. Phil tracks what could be an unknown species, while Jess hunts for evidence that a legendary creature known as Yacumama is on the hunt.

videos.title: The Beast of Andros Island
videos.overview: Braving shark-filled waters and deadly undersea tunnels, Jess and Phil probe reports of the Lusca, a sea monster said to be attacking Bahamian locals. Their hunt takes them deep into unexplored “blue holes” -- and could expose shocking military secrets.

videos.title: Ghosts of Eloise Asylum, Part 1
videos.overview: Josh Gates and fellow paranormal researchers Phil and Jess investigate a decaying mental hospital in Detroit where reported hauntings threaten all who brave its abandoned halls.

videos.title: Ghosts of Eloise Asylum, Part 2
videos.overview: After capturing an unknown entity on film, Josh Gates and his team attempt to communicate with spirits that still reside in the asylum -- including the ghost of a 10-year-old girl who drowned during a freezing hydrotherapy treatment.

videos.title: Beast of the Bayou
videos.overview: A murderous monster is said to lurk in the vast swamplands near New Orleans; Phil and Jess investigate an ancient Cajun mystery surrounding a bloodthirsty werewolf-like beast terrorizing the Bayou.

videos.title: Witches of Mexico
videos.overview: Phil and Jess travel to Monterrey, Mexico, where locals tell of encounters with witches and black magic; upon investigating these stories, they find evidence of dark spells, blood rituals and animal sacrifice.

videos.title: Ghost Town
videos.overview: Phil and Jess investigate an abandoned gold mining town haunted by its inhabitants from over a century ago. Traveling deep inside the town's deserted mines, they uncover the town's blood-soaked secrets and a multitude of paranormal activity.

videos.title: Hellfire Club
videos.overview: Phil and Jess travel to Ireland and the UK to investigate a centuries-old secret society whose most elite members were known to practice satanic worship and ritual sacrifice.

videos.title: Skinwalker Valley
videos.overview: Phil and Jess investigate Utah's Uintah Basin, a region teeming with paranormal activity -- including numerous UFO sightings, cattle mutilations and reports of shape-shifting creatures.

videos.title: Valley of UFOs
videos.overview: Phil and Jess continue their investigation into Utah's infamous Uintah Basin, where reports of UFO encounters have terrified locals. The team uncovers stunning new evidence when attempting to contact extraterrestrials.

videos.title: Transylvanian Terror
videos.overview: Phil and Jess explore the world's most haunted forest near the site of the Dracula legend and where Josh Gates had his most terrifying experience; during a night investigation, Jess finds herself being watched by someone or something sinister.

videos.title: Killer Sasquatch
videos.overview: The team heads to Alaska, America's last frontier, to investigate reports of a murderous sasquatch; Phil and Jess travel deep into the wilderness and have a truly hair-raising close encounter with what locals call "The Hairy Man."

videos.title: Death Island
videos.overview: Josh Gates sends Phil and Jess to reportedly the most haunted place in America, Mackinac Island; this remote island has experienced over 1,000 years of bloodshed, and residents report they are now plagued by terrifying paranormal activity.

videos.title: Secrets of Mackinac
videos.overview: Jess and Phil are joined by The Ghost Brothers as they continue their investigation of Mackinac Island; the teams explore a lighthouse with a dark past and realize the troubled past of the island is more widespread than they thought.

videos.title: Ghost of WW2
videos.overview: The team journeys to Okinawa, Japan to investigate reports of possessions by the spirits of people who died in the bloody battles of World War 2; they travel into the dark heart of the island where sinister caves hide shocking secrets.

videos.title: Beasts of Britain
videos.overview: Jess and Phil head to England in search of a legendary monstrous beast that's said to stalk the wilderness.

videos.title: Niagara Nightmare
videos.overview: Jess and Phil dive into the mysteries of Niagara Falls. The popular honeymoon destination is also the site of a deluge of horrors.

videos.title: Nuclear UFOs
videos.overview: In the aftermath of Japan's 2011 Fukushima nuclear disaster, citizens began reporting something truly amazing: UFOs. Phil and Jess enter a radioactive wasteland to discover the stunning truth behind these extraterrestrial encounters.

videos.title: The Madhouse
videos.overview: The group heads to West Virginia for a two-part investigation at one of the most haunted buildings in America: the Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum, a sprawling abandoned psychiatric hospital with a tragic history and countless reports of paranormal activity.

videos.title: Trapped in the Asylum
videos.overview: Josh, Phil, and Heather continue their investigation into the Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum, where thousands died after disturbing medical procedures. It's said their ghosts roam its now-abandoned halls.

videos.title: What Lurks in Loch Ness
videos.overview: Phil and Heather investigate the world's most iconic cryptid: the elusive Loch Ness Monster. Joined by actor and monster hunter Rhys Darby, they journey deep into the Scottish wilds to explore compelling new evidence beneath Loch Ness' murky waters.

videos.title: Haunted Savannah
videos.overview: The team heads south to a haunted city: Savannah, Georgia; they investigate horrifying reports of violent paranormal activity inside one of its oldest buildings, the Sorrel-Weed House, where a family died in shocking circumstances.

videos.title: City of Ghosts
videos.overview: Heather and Phil continue their investigation of Savannah's haunted past.

videos.title: Beast of the Everglades
videos.overview: Phil and Heather journey into the Florida Everglades on the hunt for the Skunk Ape, a bloodthirsty cryptid said to be menacing in both size and stench; tracking it closely, the team heads deep into the swamps before having an unforgettable encounter.

videos.title: Castle of Terror
videos.overview: The team goes to England to explore Chillingham, Britain's most haunted castle; thousands died in brutal battles on its grounds or by horrifying tortures in its dungeons; now, hostile spirits are said to roam the medieval building, seeking vengeance.

videos.title: The Dogman Conspiracy
videos.overview: The team investigates reports of what some believe is a government conspiracy: the Dogman; this half-wolf, half-man monster is said to stalk the Michigan wilderness, and some even say this creature was created by the US military.

videos.title: Chateau of Horror
videos.overview: Heather and Phil travel to the most haunted chateau in France to investigate terrifying stories of hostile ghosts linked to strange and savage murders. As they investigate, it becomes clear that the castle hosts more paranormal forces than they imagined.

videos.title: Beast of Boggy Creek
videos.overview: The team heads to Arkansas, where a legendary swamp monster has terrorized the small, rural town of Fouke for over a century.

videos.title: Secrets of the Nazi Occult
videos.overview: Phil and Heather journey to the Czech Republic to investigate a castle reportedly built over a literal Nazi portal to hell.

videos.title: Nazi Occult Underworld Revealed
videos.overview: Heather and Phil continue their deep dive into Nazi occult activity in nearby Poland where they investigate Nazi strongholds that harbor terrifying secrets.

videos.title: Werewolves of France
videos.overview: Heather and Phil travel to France to track down werewolves that have terrorized the locals for centuries. As their investigation deepens, they must figure out if this beast is supernatural or an elusive wolf not yet known to science.

videos.title: Ghosts of the Mayan Ruins
videos.overview: Heather and Phil travel to an ancient Mayan city in search of a spirit named the Stone Lady. But these aged ruins carry more threats besides vengeful spirits: poisonous snakes, scorpions, and tunnels on the verge of collapse.

videos.title: Descent Into the Mayan Underworld
videos.overview: In part two of this investigation, Phil and Heather descend deep into the Mayan underworld to explore a vast subterranean cave believed to be the realm of menacing, ancient spirits.

videos.title: A 'Squatch Above the Rest
videos.overview: Phil and Heather journey into the Kentucky wilderness, searching for sasquatches rumored to be highly intelligent.

videos.title: Terror Behind Bars
videos.overview: Heather and Phil head to Tennessee's Brushy Mountain Penitentiary to investigate terrifying reports of possession and confront the violent, powerful, and hostile forces lurking in its remains.

videos.title: Secrets of Spike Island
videos.overview: Josh and Heather investigate Spike Island, Ireland's most brutal prison, after hearing shocking paranormal claims from visitors and former inmates. Have centuries of torture and death caused the island's spirits to finally break free?

videos.title: Spike Island (2)
videos.overview: Heather and Josh complete their investigation of the haunted prison, Spike Island.

videos.title: Curse of the Conjuring
videos.overview: Phil and Heather travel to the location of the original Conjuring House to investigate a family's claims that similar dark paranormal activity is haunting their home.

videos.title: Arctic UFOs
videos.overview: Phil and Heather scour the skies and dive the valley's depths using cutting-edge tech in search of the truth behind the mysterious Hessdalen Lights in Norway.

videos.title: Frozen Aliens
videos.overview: Phil and Heather continue their investigation into claims of alien activity in Norway's Hessdalen Valley, accompanied by chilling reports of creatures visiting us on Earth; using the latest tech, they attempt first contact.

videos.title: Spanish Zombies
videos.overview: The team visits Galicia in search of the Santa Compaña -- an unholy horde of the undead terrorising rural Spain. Their quest for these Spanish zombies leads them to a remote monastery in the countryside, rumoured to be the site of dark rituals.

videos.title: Texas Chupacabra
videos.overview: Heather and Phil sniff out the trail of a vampiric Chupacabra said to be terrorizing eastern Texas. Joined by a new high-tech hound, can their robot companion help them catch this Badlands bloodsucker in the act?

videos.title: Rock of Nightmares
videos.overview: Phil and Heather explore miles of abandoned tunnels inside the Rock of Gibraltar in pursuit of a ghostly local legend: "The Mad Monk". Digging deeper into its bloody history leads them to a notoriously violent prison, where the walls are built from bones.

videos.title: The Bridgewater Triangle
videos.overview: Massachusetts' Bridgewater Triangle is America's leading hotspot for all things unexplained. UFOs, cryptids and even supernatural encounters. Heather and Phil's investigation pushes them towards the horrifying Hockomock Swamp. The center of the Triangle.

videos.title: Welcome to the Real Derry
videos.overview: Stephen King's IT features several scary locations based on actual landmarks in Bangor, ME. When Heather and Phil learn that many of those sites have horrifying real-life ghost stories of their own, they must investigate the locals' claims for themselves.

videos.title: Secrets of Vulture City
videos.overview: Joined by Jack Osbourne, Heather travels to Arizona and investigates the eerie remains of Vulture City, a ghost town long stalked by Gold Rush-era ghosts. However, they soon discover there may be a darker, more ancient force at work.

videos.title: Atomic Ape Cat
videos.overview: In the forests of Washington's Columbia River Gorge, Phil and Heather hunt a monstrous black cat with an ape-like face. Clues lead to a WW2-era nuclear facility that could be to blame, but they must find the creature before it finds them.

videos.title: Blackbeard's Ghost
videos.overview: Heather and Phil explore North Carolina's Ocracoke Island, where locals fear the ghost of Blackbeard is lingering. Is the legendary pirate's restless spirit protecting hidden treasure, or seeking vengeance upon the living?

videos.title: Terror Below Deck
videos.overview: Phil and Heather board the USS Hornet, a haunted WWII aircraft carrier said to be crawling with spirits -- both good and evil. Exploring its shadowy decks, they confront eerie signs that the ship's sailors may still be guarding it from beyond the grave.

videos.title: God of the Underworld
videos.overview: Phil & Heather travel to Predjama Castle, once ruled by a brutal robber baron feared for his cruelty. Exploring the vast web of caves beneath the cliffside fortress, they seek clues that an ancient god of the underworld may be haunting the castle instead.

videos.title: Terrors of Trinidad
videos.overview: Reports of shadowy figures and malevolent spirits from Caribbean folklore draw Phil and Heather to Trinidad. They explore a notorious plantation and an abandoned island once used as a leper colony, searching for the source of the activity

videos.title: Nightmare Island
videos.overview: In Trinidad, Heather and Phil continue to confront terrifying claims of demonic possession and Obeah curses, tracing the sinister forces that locals say still grip the island.

videos.title: Thunderbird
videos.overview: Recent sightings of a massive bird and reports of missing livestock send Phil and Heather deep into western Pennsylvania. On the hunt for the legendary Thunderbird, they search for proof of the creature that has haunted legends for generations.

videos.title: The Spanish Boogeyman
videos.overview: Phil and Heather head to Belmonte Castle in La Mancha, Spain, said to be haunted by the Spanish Boogeyman. Inside the castle, they discover surprising secrets that reveal the truth behind the terrifying legend.

videos.title: Ghosts of Gettysburg
videos.overview: The team heads to the site of the bloodiest battle ever on U.S. soil, where witnesses claim to see phantom soldiers roaming the battlefields at night, and shadow figures haunting historic buildings like the Jennie Wade House and Farnsworth Inn.
